stations.title: Ravi
stations.note: Every morning, in the shop inbox.

captions: Moss can talk now. Ravi wants every inbox message tagged before he opens it.
Asked about gnats in a pothos, Moss replies with a friendly paragraph.
You write the prompts and a strict parser, in three tasks.
Now every reply comes back in one shape your code can read.
Same inbox, sorted in minutes. Moss answers in a shape code can trust.
